When there are multiple adjectives preceding a noun, they should be arranged according to the following order: "[1. Opinion] [2. Size] [3. Age] [4. Shape] [5. Color] [6. Origin] [7. Material] [8. Purpose] Noun"
Option A: "midsize old grey Brazilian sweater" (1) "old" falls under the opinion category. (2) "grey" falls under the color category. (3) "midsize" falls under the size category. (4) "Brazilian" falls under the origin category. (5) "sweater" falls under the purpose category. The adjective order for option A is [1. opinion] [2. color] [3. size] [6. origin] [8. purpose] (or, in numeric terms, 1 2 3 6 8). Since 1 < 2 < 3 < 6 < 8 is correct, option A has the correct order.
Option B: "midsize grey Brazilian old sweater" (1) "grey" falls under the color category. (2) "Brazilian" falls under the origin category. (3) "old" falls under the age category. (4) "midsize" falls under the size category. (5) "sweater" falls under the purpose category. The adjective order for option B is [2. color] [6. origin] [3. age] [4. size] [8. purpose] (or, in numeric terms, 2 6 3 4 8). Since 2 > 6 > 3 > 4 > 8 is incorrect, option B does not have the correct order. Therefore, the answer is (A).
